segs: A full schedule isn't always an organized one.
How many appointments slip away every month?
If your calendar lives on paper or in WhatsApp, you're not alone.
And confirming one by one steals your afternoon.
With OneTap, your schedule runs by professional, with zero overlaps.
And it sends WhatsApp reminders at no cost per message.
Every morning, you know how your day looks.
First month free. No card required.
